title: nb gate hook: $(which nb) and --also=<id> are not handled
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

- `$(which nb) freeze x`, `nb --json freeze x` and `nb "freeze" x` produce no prompt. SPEC says nb invoked by name or path; it also frames the hook as a guard against a well-meaning agent.
- `nb confirm con-x --also=hyp-y` prompts, but the follow-on line is missing (reviewer-reported, not checked).
- "proposed by Claude" is appended for every verb, including retract (cosmetic).
